resources.string: Sign in to discover your devices and open terminals, files, and web services across your tailnet.
Tailscale is built in. Save your personal and work tailnets, including custom control servers, and switch between them. One tailnet connects at a time.
Open SSH terminals and manage files with SFTP on tailnet devices or traditional SSH hosts. Organize hosts into groups, pin favorites, and return to open terminals from Sessions.
Open private dashboards and everyday websites in the tabbed browser. It uses the shared local proxy automatically. Save favorites and find text without leaving NovaScale.
